summary: Add a compile+registration gate that admits a command to the contract only if it satisfies all four properties: (a) typed (schemars::JsonSchema input+output), (b) dry-runnable (preview returns the resulting StudioEditProposal diff without mutating authority), (c) receipted (non-dry-run emits an EventLedger receipt under a studio.* event_family with KernelActor attribution), (d) undoable (produces a StudioHistoryEntry, participates in per-file undo/redo).
